name: button
description: Triggers an action on the current page, such as submitting a form. For navigation to another page use link.

use.when: an action on this page: send, save, remove, undo.
use.not: going somewhere, which is a link, or decorating.
use.with: a form, so it works without a script.

label.description: Visible text. Say what happens, for example 'Save note'.

context.title: Extra words for screen readers
context.description: Extra words added to the accessible name but not shown, so a compact label like 'Remove' still reads as 'Remove card'.

variant.description: quiet is a borderless button for per-item controls that live in the quiet layer.

name.description: Form field name, sent with the form when type is submit.

value.description: Form value sent when this button submits the form.

disabled.description: Avoid: a disabled button gives no reason and drops out of reach. Keep it pressable and say what is wrong on submit.

busy.description: Already sent and waiting: aria-disabled, so it keeps focus and ignores presses until the page answers. Set by the script on submit; set it in the page only for a request already under way.

pressed.description: For a button that turns something on and off: renders aria-pressed. Keep the label the same either way.

action.description: The id of an action record to run when pressed. The button is rendered inside its own form posting to /act/<id>, so do not put it inside another form.

from.description: With action, the page to return to afterwards.

keyboard.does: moves focus to and from the button

wcag.notes: 44px minimum target. 7:1 contrast on all variants. Focus ring 3px with 3:1 contrast. The press ring stays visible after release so the activation is felt. Disabled buttons leave the tab order, so keep destructive or important actions enabled and validate on submit instead. A form is sent once: its pressed button is aria-disabled until the next page arrives, so a double press does not create or delete twice. An on and off button has aria-pressed and a pressed-in look, not colour alone.

machine.identify: The accessible name is the visible label plus any context text, for example 'Remove card'. Target by role and name.
machine.operate: Click it, or focus it and press Enter or Space. A submit button inside a form submits that form. A button whose form posts to /act/<id> runs one of the person's actions. A button with aria-disabled=true was pressed and is waiting for the page to answer; pressing it again does nothing. A button inside a quiet control bar is faded until hovered or focused, but it is always present, focusable, and clickable.
